scope: Management code, current classification, evidence preservation and documentation. Existing fine-style findings remain open; this check did not repaint or regenerate art.

fixed_code_findings.issue: Explicit uniquely named batches created an empty unclassified parent.
fixed_code_findings.fix: Discover using the original file path before structural grouping.

fixed_code_findings.issue: A reservation could succeed after the final config check during registry publication.
fixed_code_findings.fix: Hold the shared config lock through final checks and both derived-file replacements.

fixed_code_findings.issue: A symlink at the derived HTML path could redirect publication onto original art.
fixed_code_findings.fix: Reject symlinks in every component of the fixed HTML publication path.

fixed_code_findings.issue: A live input-reference symlink could enter the frozen portable inventory.
fixed_code_findings.fix: Prune active writer trees by their lexical location before traversing files.

Marked old prime v002 adoption as historical and explicitly recorded source reuse by v003.
Restricted kangaroo expansion and red-panda eye-catch quality observations to their own reviewed batches.
